title: schedule.event_created v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the schedule module, in the transaction of the change, when an event is added to a calendar: made by the member, read by Scout from an email, or applied from a provider's batch. `schedule.event_changed` and `schedule.event_cancelled` (v1) carry the same fields. Ids, enums and times only: no title, place, notes or attendees (readers ask the API). Expanding the occurrences of a series publishes nothing. Workspace-scoped.

owner.description: The member whose calendar it is.

source.description: The record it was read from, if any: `conversations.message` and its id.

when.description: An RFC 3339 time with an offset, or a date when the event is all-day.
